source.license_note: Real upstream victoria PR #10312; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: SearchTenants returns tenants from outside the requested date, so per-date tenant queries report tenants that have no data on that date.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the storage package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: searchTenantsOnDate discards the index entry tail and adds every tenant regardless of date, instead of comparing the entry's date against the requested date.

ops_fault.description: Per-date tenant listings include tenants that have no samples on the requested date, returning incorrect SearchTenants results for narrow time ranges.
detection_keywords: SearchTenants returns wrong tenants for a time range
localization_keywords: tail returned by unmarshalCommonPrefix is discarded
date from index entry tail is never compared
tenant added unconditionally for every matching prefix
missing keyDate vs requested date check
repair_keywords: unmarshal keyDate from tail with encoding.UnmarshalUint64
only add tenant when date == 0 or keyDate == date
filter tenants by the entry date

visible_context.issue_text: Listing tenants for a specific day returns tenants that have no data on that day; narrowing the query time range does not narrow the tenant list as expected.
error_logs: SearchTenants(tr) returned tenants outside the requested date range
